terms.gloss: castrate, geld (a man or an animal)
evidence: Plaut. Merc. 272: ego illunc hircum castrārī volō
terms.comment: Also of pruning plants and of straining wine (Pliny).

phrases.latin: Profectō ego illunc hircum castrārī volō, rūrī quī vōbīs exhibet negōtium.
phrases.english: I really do want that he-goat castrated, the one that gives you trouble on the farm.
